findings.note: Glossary drift on “Remove”: the delta uses «Xóa» (delete/erase) six times, while the same composer-chip action elsewhere is «Gỡ» (ui.chat.composer_media.remove_attachment «Gỡ tệp đính kèm») and this namespace’s own chip uses «Bỏ» (compose.remove «Bỏ {name}»). These controls only take an image out of the message being written or rescheduled; «Xóa hình ảnh» in the reschedule dialog reads as deleting the picture itself. «Gỡ» matches the existing attachment precedent and the real effect.

“Image” is «hình ảnh» in the other 21 delta keys (and library.category.images / canvas.files.images) but shortened to «Hình» here and in open; «Hình 2/3» also reads as document figure numbering. It is alt text/aria/tooltip only (no width budget), and it is concatenated with «Hình ảnh này …» in the chip’s aria-label, so the two forms meet in one announcement.
